south-fork.name: South Fork
south-fork.title: South Fork Market Update & Living Guide | Riverview, FL | Shauna Banning
south-fork.description: Monthly South Fork real estate market update plus an honest local guide: amenities, CDD and HOA costs, schools, commute and flood tips. From Shauna Banning, Coldwell Banker Realty.
south-fork.h1: South Fork, Riverview: The Honest Guide
south-fork.intro: Newer homes, a resort-style amenity center and a price point that still works for a lot of families. Here's what it's really like, and what it really costs.
south-fork.life_h2: Pools, Parks & Room to Spread Out
south-fork.life_lead: South Fork is a collection of neighborhoods built around a shared amenity center, with sidewalks, ponds and parks throughout.
life: The centerpiece: a pool, spa and clubhouse that host summer weekends and birthday parties.
An on-site gym, so you can skip the drive to a membership.
Tennis and basketball courts plus playgrounds spread through the neighborhoods.
Sidewalks and walking paths loop past retention ponds. Good for a morning walk or an evening stroll with the dog.
Groceries, coffee and restaurants are a short drive away along US-301 and Big Bend Road.
I-75 is close for trips north to Tampa or south toward Sarasota.
costs: Billed on your property tax bill. Varies by section and lot.
Low by most standards, but some sub-areas run higher. Check the exact association.
Get quotes during your inspection period.
Not included in a standard homeowners policy. Check the FEMA flood map.
tips: There's more than one "South Fork"
South Fork is made up of several subdivisions, and Southfork Lakes is a separate community with its own HOA. Confirm exactly which association a home belongs to.
The CDD hides on your tax bill
It's not a separate monthly bill, so it's easy to miss. Ask for the exact amount on any home you like.
Drive it at rush hour
US-301, Big Bend and I-75 back up at peak times. Drive your real commute before you make an offer.
Get insurance quotes early
Roof age moves your premium more than almost anything. Quote it during your inspection period, not after closing.
faq: How much is the CDD in South Fork?
Recent listings show roughly $2,000 to $2,700 a year, billed on the property tax bill. It varies by section and lot, so check the exact amount for any home you're considering.
What are the HOA fees in South Fork?
Most listings show low monthly dues, roughly $10 to $45 a month, though some sub-areas run higher. Confirm the exact association and fee for the home.
What schools serve South Fork?
South Fork is in Hillsborough County Public Schools, and zoning varies by section. I'll confirm the assigned schools for any address you're considering.
How far is South Fork from MacDill AFB?
About 22 to 25 miles, or roughly 35 to 55 minutes at weekday morning rush depending on your route. See my Where to Live Near MacDill guide.

triple-creek.name: Triple Creek
triple-creek.title: Triple Creek Market Update & Living Guide | Riverview, FL | Shauna Banning
triple-creek.description: Monthly Triple Creek real estate market update plus an honest local guide: amenities, CDD and HOA costs, schools, commute and flood tips. From Shauna Banning, Coldwell Banker Realty.
triple-creek.h1: Triple Creek, Riverview: The Honest Guide
triple-creek.intro: About 1,000 acres of newer homes, multiple amenity centers and an elementary school inside the community. Here's the full picture, costs included.
triple-creek.life_h2: Amenity Centers, Parks & a School Next Door
triple-creek.life_lead: Triple Creek was planned around its amenities, with more than one clubhouse and plenty of green space.
life: Multiple amenity centers with pools, plus a splash pad for little ones.
A fitness center, sports fields and courts for tennis and basketball.
A fenced dog park, so the pup gets a run too.
Dawson Elementary sits inside Triple Creek, which makes school drop-off short for many families.
Parks and playgrounds are spread through the villages.
Builders are still active in some villages, so you'll find both new and resale homes.
costs: Billed on your property tax bill. Varies by village and lot.
Low, but some villages have more than one association. Check every fee.
Newer roofs usually quote lower. Get quotes during inspection.
Check the FEMA flood map for the exact lot.
tips: The CDD is the big number
HOA dues are low, but the CDD often runs $3,000 or more a year on the tax bill. Compare total monthly cost, not just the HOA.
Some villages have two associations
Ask for every association fee on the home, not just the master HOA.
It's farther east than it looks
Triple Creek sits east of US-301, so drives to Tampa and MacDill run longer than the rest of Riverview. Drive it at rush hour.
Construction traffic is temporary
Building is still going on in parts of the community. Visit on a weekday to see what daily life is like right now.
faq: How much is the CDD in Triple Creek?
Recent listings show CDD assessments often around $3,000 or more a year, billed on the property tax bill. It varies by village and lot.
What schools serve Triple Creek?
Listings most often show Warren Hope Dawson Elementary (inside the community), Barrington Middle and Sumner High. Always confirm zoning for the exact address with the district.
What amenities does Triple Creek have?
Multiple amenity centers with pools, a splash pad, a fitness center, sports fields, tennis and basketball courts, a dog park, parks and playgrounds.
How far is Triple Creek from MacDill AFB?
Roughly 25 to 28 miles, or about 40 to 60 minutes at weekday morning rush. See my Where to Live Near MacDill guide.

river-hills.name: River Hills
river-hills.title: River Hills Country Club Market Update & Living Guide | Valrico, FL | Shauna Banning
river-hills.description: Monthly River Hills (Valrico) real estate market update plus an honest local guide: the country club, HOA costs, A-rated schools, commute and flood tips. From Shauna Banning, Coldwell Banker Realty.
river-hills.h1: River Hills, Valrico: The Honest Guide
river-hills.intro: An established golf community with mature trees, bigger lots and A-rated schools. Here's what living here is really like, club membership included.
river-hills.life_lead: River Hills is built around River Hills Country Club, with established neighborhoods tucked along the fairways and conservation areas.
life: An 18-hole course with a clubhouse. Golf membership is separate from the HOA.
Many listings say HOA dues include a social membership with pool, fitness and dining access. Confirm what's included for the home you're considering.
Older neighborhoods mean established landscaping and more space between homes.
Listings commonly show Lithia Springs Elementary, Randall Middle and Newsome High.
Shopping and dining in Brandon and FishHawk are a short drive away.
Many homes back up to fairways, ponds or wooded preserve.
costs: Varies by section. Ask exactly what it covers, including any club access.
Full golf membership is in addition to the HOA. Only some owners join.
Many established sections don't have one. Confirm on the tax bill.
Older homes mean roof age matters a lot. Quote it during inspection.
tips: Know what the HOA covers
Some sections include a club social membership and some don't. Ask for the HOA's budget and what's included before you compare homes.
Golf is optional
You don't have to golf to live here, and many residents don't. Full golf membership is a separate cost.
Roof age drives insurance
Many homes date from the 1990s–2000s. A newer roof can save thousands a year on insurance.
Ask about the club's plans
Clubs change hands and update their plans. Ask the HOA about the club's current status and any planned assessments.
faq: What are the HOA fees in River Hills?
Recent listings show roughly $290 to $680 a quarter depending on section, and some include a social membership to the country club. Confirm the exact fee and what it covers.
Do you have to join the River Hills Country Club?
Full golf membership is separate from the HOA and optional. Many listings say HOA dues include social access, so check what's included for the specific home.
What schools serve River Hills?
Listings commonly show Lithia Springs Elementary, Randall Middle and Newsome High. Always confirm zoning for the exact address with the district.
Is there a CDD in River Hills?
Many established sections don't have a CDD, but check the property tax bill for the specific home to be sure.

waterset.name: Waterset
waterset.title: Waterset Market Update & Living Guide | Apollo Beach, FL | Shauna Banning
waterset.description: Monthly Waterset real estate market update plus an honest local guide: amenities, CDD and HOA costs, schools, MacDill commute and flood tips. From Shauna Banning, Coldwell Banker Realty.
waterset.h1: Waterset, Apollo Beach: The Honest Guide
waterset.intro: A newer master-planned community near the bay, with trails, amenity centers and schools on site. Here's what it's like, and what it costs.
waterset.life_lead: Waterset was planned around walkability, with trails, parks and amenity centers connecting the neighborhoods.
life: Resort-style pools and clubhouse space for gatherings.
A fitness center, soccer fields and tennis and basketball courts.
Walking trails, parks and playgrounds throughout the neighborhoods.
A splash pad for kids and a dog park for the pup.
Waterset Charter School (K–8) and a Montessori school (PK–K) are on site, plus district schools nearby.
Apollo Beach's waterfront, boat ramps and restaurants are minutes away.
costs: Billed on your property tax bill. Varies by village and lot.
Low, though some villages and townhomes run higher. Check the exact association.
Some amenities may sit behind an optional membership. Ask what the HOA and CDD include.
Coastal area. Check the FEMA flood zone and evacuation zone for the exact lot.
tips: Coastal means flood homework
Even newer homes built to higher standards can sit in a flood or evacuation zone. Check both for the exact lot and get a flood quote.
Know what's included
Some amenities may require an optional club membership. Ask exactly what the HOA and CDD cover.
The CDD varies by village
Two similar homes can carry very different CDD amounts. Compare total monthly cost.
US-41 and I-75 at rush hour
Most drives north run through US-41 or I-75. Drive your real commute before you commit.
faq: How much is the CDD in Waterset?
Community and builder materials show roughly $1,970 to $3,470 a year, billed on the property tax bill, varying by village and lot.
What schools serve Waterset?
Listings most often show Doby Elementary, Eisenhower Middle and East Bay High. Waterset Charter School (K–8) is also on site. Confirm zoning with the district for the exact address.
Is Waterset in a flood zone?
It depends on the lot. Waterset is in coastal south Hillsborough, so check the FEMA flood zone and evacuation zone for the specific address.
How far is Waterset from MacDill AFB?
About 25 miles, or roughly 35 to 55 minutes at weekday morning rush. See my Where to Live Near MacDill guide.

mirabay.name: MiraBay
mirabay.title: MiraBay Market Update & Living Guide | Apollo Beach, FL | Shauna Banning
mirabay.description: Monthly MiraBay real estate market update plus an honest local guide: waterfront living, amenities, CDD and HOA costs, schools, flood and insurance tips. From Shauna Banning, Coldwell Banker Realty.
mirabay.h1: MiraBay, Apollo Beach: The Honest Guide
mirabay.intro: Canals, Tampa Bay access and a resort-style clubhouse. Here's what waterfront living really looks like here, insurance and all.
mirabay.life_lead: MiraBay is built around canals with Tampa Bay access, a resort-style clubhouse and a small shopping village.
life: Many homes sit on canals with Tampa Bay access. A big draw for boaters.
Kayak and paddleboard access, no trailer needed.
Heated pools (one with a water slide) and a clubhouse with food and drink.
A fitness center plus tennis, pickleball and basketball.
A small village of shops and restaurants nearby, with golf cart access.
West-facing water means some of the best sunsets in south Hillsborough.
costs: Billed on your property tax bill and funds the community amenities.
Some listings show a few hundred dollars a year; some sections have more than one association.
Waterfront and coastal homes usually quote higher. Get quotes early.
Coastal and canal-front homes are often in flood zones. Get a quote before you make an offer.
tips: Insurance first, house second
On the water, insurance can change the whole budget. Get homeowners and flood quotes before you write an offer.
Check the flood and evacuation zone
Look up both for the exact address, and ask the seller for any flood claims history (Florida now requires the disclosure).
Know your bridge heights
If you boat, check the canal route and any fixed-bridge clearances for your boat.
Seawalls are a big-ticket item
Ask the age and condition of the seawall, and who's responsible for repairs.
faq: Does MiraBay have a CDD?
Yes. The CDD assessment is billed on the property tax bill and helps fund the community amenities. The amount varies by lot.
Is MiraBay in a flood zone?
Many homes are, since it's a coastal, canal-front community. Check the FEMA flood zone and evacuation zone for the exact address and get a flood insurance quote early.
What schools serve MiraBay?
Listings show Apollo Beach Elementary, Eisenhower Middle and Lennard High. Confirm zoning with the district for the exact address.
Does MiraBay have boat access to Tampa Bay?
Many canal-front homes have Tampa Bay access. Check the specific route and any bridge clearances for your boat.
